name: aeon_unavailable
description: The summon menu's test (FUN_0079a080): an aeon can be summoned only when it is alive, available, not removed and its recovery counter is 0.

harness.note: the real machine code of the functions; only the battle RNG function is replaced by a script (rngDraws is what the game asked for)

notes: in: the four bytes the function reads of the character: hp (Chr+0x5d0, signed 32-bit), avail (Chr+0xdd4, the character can be summoned at all), blocked (Chr+0xdcd, removed for good), recover (Chr+0x6d8, the recovery counter). out.ret: 0 = can be summoned, 1 = cannot.
Every stored answer is the machine's own: FUN_0079a080 of FFX.exe run for real on random character states.
